8.4.2 LdCom_TpTxConfirmation
[SWS_LDCOM_00028] Definition of callback function LdCom_TpTxConfirmation
Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02109
⌈
Service Name
LdCom_TpTxConfirmation
Syntax
void LdCom_TpTxConfirmation (
PduIdType id,
Std_ReturnType result
)
Service ID [hex]
0x48
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
id
Identification of the transmitted I-PDU.
Parameters (in)
result
E_OK: The PDU was transmitted. E_NOT_OK: Transmission of
the PDU failed.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
This function is called after the I-PDU has been transmitted on its network, the result indicates
whether the transmission was successful or not.
Available via
LdCom.h
⌋
